note: The same schema as gitignore-vectors.json, kept separate because those 34 cases are the matcher contract and these pin one property of the decision order: a last-segment bucket is a candidate source, never an answer, so a later matching rule still wins and a later bucket rule still beats an earlier one. Every case here is decided by the last matching line of its single rule file.
